title: A tool palette in acre-gui creates boxes, ellipses, text, lines, arrows, polygons and polylines
body: Gestures as in `tmp-claude/2026-11-23-overnight/create-research.md`: one-shot tools in the toolbar; drag corner to corner for a box or ellipse, with snapping; a click places a text and opens its edit field; a drag from one object to another makes a line or arrow, ending by name on a shape (naming it if needed) and at a point elsewhere; clicks add polygon and polyline points, the first point closes a polygon, Done and Cancel finish. Each creation is one edit and selects the new node. A right-click menu on an object offers Delete and Duplicate.
